recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d' -i app/build.gradle
echo -e "storeFile=/dev/null\nstorePassword=storePass\nkeyAlias=alias\nkeyPassword=keyPass" >> keystore.properties
git clone https://github.com/obfusk/gradlew.py.git
gradlew.py/gradlew.py --version 8.11.1 -v assembleRelease
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/*unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
